store.mode-open.say: <path> is mode <mode>, so somebody other than you can read it. Run: chmod 600 <path>

store.already-holds.say: <store> already holds a key under <service>/<account>, and that key belongs to an installation on this machine. Writing over it would destroy the only proof that installation is itself, and nothing can restore it.

store.read-back.say: wrote a value to <store> and read back something else

store.no-key-store.say:
no-key-store: <reason>
This machine has nowhere to keep a private key. Set EVALATION_KEY_STORE=file to keep it in a file only you can read, under ~/.evalation-plugin/keys.

store.file.say: a file only you can read
